message: それでお役に立てるなら

name: Synn
message: 「All right, I think that wraps up today's work」

name: Ria
message: 「Good work~. Here's some tea~」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you very much」

name: Sally
message: 「Want some snacks~\s04」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm glad today's meeting came together so well」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, totally」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aaaalright, time to give club activities my all!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hoho, in high spirits, are we?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「My burning heartbeat pierces the heavens!」

name: Sally
message: 「By the way, Prez」

name: Synn
message: 「Hm?」

name: Sally
message: 「Why has this tape recorder just been sitting here untouched for a while now?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aah…… Even though everyone went out of their way not to touch it……」

name: Sally
message: 「I'm itching so badly I can't hold back, so I'm gonna press it! Hiyah!」

name: Helena
message: 「Good day, members of the Student Council!」

name: Helena
message: 「That said, the only one I need this time is Synn-chan」

name: Synn
message: 「Me?」

name: Helena
message: 「Melilot says she has a favor to ask of Synn-chan, so head to the library after school」

name: Helena
message: 「Whatever you do, don't stand her up and make Melilot feel lonely, okay? That's all!」

name: Helena
message: 「Furthermore, this tape will now automatically――」

name: Misa
message: 「A magnificent ignore, dear Sister\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「Sis could've just come to tell us in person……\s02」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So, heading to the library now?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. I was planning on going to look some stuff up anyway」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You've been practically living at the library lately, Synn」

name: Lolotte
message: 「This is what's commonly known as a 'booksheep,' isn't it」

name: Misa
message: 「Nobody says that……」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I'm doing it because I want to」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Want us to help out?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nah. I'm good」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gotcha. Well, do your best」

name: Synn
message: 「Hello, Melilot-san」

name: Melilot
message: 「Oh, Sakura-kun. Are you here to do some research today as well?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes」

name: Synn
message: 「Also, I heard you had some business with me……」

name: Melilot
message: 「Oh my……」

name: Melilot
message: 「Um, who did you hear that from…… No, I know. It was Helena, wasn't it……」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes……」

name: Melilot
message: 「I see…… Good grief, that Helena……」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, was that a problem?」

name: Melilot
message: 「No, not at all」

name: Melilot
message: 「It's just that I had intended to ask you directly myself, Sakura-kun……」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, I see. I don't really mind, though」

name: Melilot
message: 「I'm the one who minds」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh……」
Melilot-san really is so conscientious, isn't she.

name: Synn
message: 「Um, so what was it you needed」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes. That's right」

name: Melilot
message: 「I have a favor to ask of you, Sakura-kun, seeing how well you filled in for Helena yesterday」

name: Melilot
message: 「Would you be willing to formally take my place as an acting librarian?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh... Me!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I heard that you volunteered on your own yesterday, Sakura-kun」

name: Melilot
message: 「I could leave it to the library committee members, of course, but...」

name: Melilot
message: 「I feel like I can rely on you much more, Sakura-kun」

name: Melilot
message: 「Naturally, this is only if you're willing to take it on, though」

name: Synn
message: 「But I don't have any qualifications or anything...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes. That's why you wouldn't be performing official duties--strictly acting as a stand-in」

name: Melilot
message: 「Specifically, I'd like to entrust you with patrolling the library while I'm away」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't have any idea what kind of work I'm supposed to do, you know?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I will teach you all of that myself」

name: Melilot
message: 「It isn't anything particularly difficult, and of course, I will take full responsibility」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you really think someone like me will be okay...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「...Do you dislike this library, Sakura-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「No way! That's not true at all」

name: Melilot
message: 「Then there is no problem whatsoever」

name: Melilot
message: 「Besides, I trust you, Sakura-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot-san...」

name: Melilot
message: 「I won't force you, of course, so what do you say...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, um, please let me do it!」

name: Synn
message: 「If someone like me can be of help to you, Melilot-san, I'd gladly accept!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Is that so...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Hearing you say that is a big help to me as well.」

name: Synn
message: 「You've helped me out a lot too, Melilot-san, and besides, I'm a little interested.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Interested...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Do you mean, in me?」

name: Synn
message: 「Aah! N-No, I mean, in the librarian work!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Heehee... I know, I'm just teasing.」

name: Synn
message: 「Please don't startle me like that...」
Well, of course...
It was because I was interested in Melilot-san that I kept talking to her about all sorts of things.
Since when had she started occupying my mind this much...

name: Melilot
message: 「You seemed a little too tense, after all.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Feel free to relax your shoulders and take it easy.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I'll do my best...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Now then, I'm terribly sorry to ask so soon, but...」

name: Melilot
message: 「I have an errand on Sunday and will need to be away from the library again.」

name: Synn
message: 「That sure is sudden.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Could I ask you to fill in as substitute librarian?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Thank you very much.」
Right away, I follow Melilot-san around and get a rough rundown of the substitute librarian duties.
The basic tasks are mainly collecting general books. Organizing. Storing. And assisting visitors with browsing.
What's being left to me is mostly just acting as a monitor, though...
Still, with a mix of things I know and things I don't, my head is spinning.
Yet when Melilot-san teaches me, it all sinks smoothly into my head--it's really amazing.

name: Melilot
message: 「Well then, Sakura-kun.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I'll be counting on you to look after the library the day after tomorrow.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes, leave it to me!」
Even though what I can do is pretty limited.
Still, I'll do everything I can so I can be of help to Melilot-san.
